function.name: load_skill
function.description: Load the entry instructions for an installed skill. Pass only its exact registered name, for example skillName='kooboo-coding'. Do not pass a file path or append references/, assets/ or scripts/ to the skill name. To read a referenced document, use read_skill_resource with the same skillName and a separate resourceName relative to the skill root, for example resourceName='references/Scenario/app-building/index.md'. Reuse already loaded entry instructions within the conversation unless they changed.

skillName.description: Exact installed skill name from the available skills list, such as kooboo-coding. Not a file path. For a resource document use read_skill_resource with separate skillName and resourceName fields.
